title: Compactly Supported Finite-Energy Stationary Solutions of the Three-Dimensional Navier-Stokes Equations
summary: We construct nonzero compactly supported stationary distributional solutions $u\in L^2(\mathbb{R}^3;\mathbb{R}^3)$ of the unforced incompressible Navier--Stokes equations, together with compactly supported pressures in $L^1$, with both norms arbitrarily small. The construction addresses the three-dimensional finite-energy endpoint at which the usual single-scale intermittent Mikado mechanism loses its algebraic gain against the Laplacian.
